name: dsh-desktop-backend
description: Bundled DeepSeek Harness runtime for the dsh-desktop shell (installed into node_modules and shipped in app resources)
//: The harness is pinned exactly. `@deepseek-ai/dsh` publishes pre-releases (there has never been a stable release), so a caret range would also accept the next 0.2.x; the pin plus backend/package-lock.json is what makes a build reproducible. When you bump it, also update the allowScripts keys below: a key that no longer matches its exact version means npm 12 blocks that package's install scripts, and the native pieces (node-pty's spawn-helper, koffi) fail later at runtime instead of at install time. `npm run backend:install` asserts the load-bearing ones.
